newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sales limited - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sales limited - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well established, few sales steady to firm. Inquiry fair, demand rather light.

Sales confirmed on 1,800 slaughter steers and 1,100 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 94,700 head confirmed including 18,100 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 66.50.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 980 lbs 66.00.
Wk to date - 94,700 last week - 75,700 last year - 62,400
